title: Plan a Picnic
learning_objectives: Pick foods that give you energy
Decide what to do in order

events.description: You're planning a picnic in the park with 2 friends! You have 5 coins. First, let's pick some food. What do you want to bring?

choices.label: A basket of fruit
choices.effect: A basket of fruit for everyone! So colorful and full of energy!

events.description: Your friends are here! One friend wants to play tag and the other wants to eat first. What do you do?

choices.label: Eat first, then play!
choices.effect: Great plan! Now everyone has energy to play after eating!

choices.label: Play first, then eat!
choices.effect: So much fun running around! Now everyone is hungry for the picnic!

events.description: There's a drink stand nearby! Juice costs 2 coins. Do you have enough coins left?

choices.label: Buy juice to share
choices.effect: Juice for the group! What a kind thing to share!

choices.label: Drink water from the fountain
choices.effect: Water is refreshing and free! Smart choice!

recap_template: You planned an amazing picnic! You picked food, decided when to eat and play, shared with friends, and used your coins wisely. What a great day!
positive_framing_rules: Never say the student spent too much or made a mistake
Frame all food choices as giving energy
ai_variation_allowed: Add a surprise like a butterfly or a rainbow
Vary the friend reactions to choices
